checks.name: g6a-make-check-red-at-judgment-commit
checks.summary: Under the revised G6a, freshness for every claim make check re-executes is satisfied by make check being green at the judgment commit. It is NOT green. devbox run --pure -- make check at a258ed2569205dec3585d303ecb7f1c4fdba8254 fails in the test stage: TestManifestDependencySurface/VerifyDependencyCoverage reports 'real manifest fails dependency coverage: component api has a test import dependency on provider that is in neither dependencies nor verification_dependencies', FAIL github.com/takushi/agentic-loop-foundation/v2/internal/ci, make: *** [Makefile:94: test] Error 1, exit status 2. Attribution was measured, not argued, in two throwaway detached worktrees: the same test is GREEN at a614414 (the integration parent carrying V2-072 and V2-074) and RED at 39d2e80 (V2-022's own observation commit). The red is introduced by internal/api/live_dogfood_test.go importing internal/provider (line 60) without manifest coverage, which landed with the dogfood. This re-execution also contradicts the A21 claim that go test ./... was green on commit A's committed state; the contradiction is a direct re-run at the recorded commit. This gate cannot pay G6a: the cure requires editing ci/components.json or internal/api, both prohibited paths for a gate, because a gate judges and does not repair. go clean -testcache followed by make evidence-all was deliberately NOT run: reissuing 23 component evidences against a tree whose make check is red would attest a red tree, and paying it cannot cure G2 (partial live records), G6b (stale observation) or the 11 missing capability evidences, so the payment would change nothing about the verdict.

checks.name: g6b-intersection-measured-not-empty
checks.summary: G6b was measured mechanically as the rule requires. The exercising package is internal/api (live_dogfood_test.go); go list -deps -test ./internal/api yields 13 in-module package directories, plus the harness scripts/firestore-emulator.sh and the claude CLI path. Both observation commits are recorded in the evidence (6888edf47 for runs 1 and 2, 39d2e80 for the confirming run), so G6b requirement (1) holds. Requirement (2) fails: git diff --name-only 39d2e80..a258ed2569205dec3585d303ecb7f1c4fdba8254 lists 56 files of which 26 are .go files inside the exercised package set (internal/api/api_test.go, internal/application/{outbox,ports,provider_registry,publication,service}.go and tests, internal/domain/repository.go, internal/provider/{adapters,compatibility,handoff,provider}.go and tests, internal/runner/{forgepublish,publishsource}.go and tests, internal/store/firestore/store.go, internal/store/memory/store.go and tests), the V2-072 and V2-074 changes; for 6888edf the intersection is 27 files. The intersection is not empty, so re-observation is required regardless of reason. Re-observation is not executable by this gate: the V2-022 ledger stands at 23 of its 24-invocation threshold and this gate is barred from starting a Provider CLI. Even if the records had been passed they would not be fresh at this commit.

checks.name: e22-11-and-needs-input-reachability-remeasured
checks.summary: Both newly discovered defects were re-verified at the judgment commit and both block M5. E22-11: registered as V2-079 (status queued); internal/store/firestore's RequirementsPage passes a cursor that already carries the collection prefix back into StartAfter, so a cursor the Backlog route itself returned is refused with HTTP 400 by the next request against real Firestore semantics, which makes cap-backlog-visibility's declared user action (paging the Backlog) impossible and keeps that capability failed. needs-input: internal/domain/model.go admits RequirementNeedInput only from framing, active or evaluating; the only command out of captured is RequirementStartFraming; grep over internal/application non-test sources finds zero occurrences of RequirementStartFraming or RequirementStart, so no Requirement created through the real surface can ever reach a status where asking is legal - cap-human-input-request's success condition is unobservable, not merely unexercised. Each defect alone leaves a Release Contract capability unexercisable, and release-contract.md section 3 refuses Stable promotion if even one capability is unexercisable, so each alone is sufficient to block the first Stable promotion.

checks.summary: Roadmap M5 has four completion conditions. (1) 'Dogfood this Foundation Repository as a Preview target': the exercise ran at preview-local (A5, A6 and the sixteen live sub-exercises), but release-contract.md section 3 defines Preview substantiation as ALL Release Contract capabilities succeeding in the Preview environment; measured outcome is 1 of 12 (cap-requirement-intake only) - NOT satisfied. (3) 'Promotion stops on docs-only drift': satisfied by A17's positive half (one byte flipped in a documentation member refuses the candidate with a source-drift error naming docs/preview/index.md) and by ev-v2-021-release's passed drift checks. (4) 'Only a candidate with evidence for every capability becomes Stable': the guard is witnessed on both sides by A17 (the real tree's refusal names exactly the 11 evidence-less capability ids; the eligible set is exactly cap-requirement-intake), but the substantive condition this gate exists to decide - the first Stable promotion - is impossible: promotion condition 2 of release-contract.md section 4 requires every capability to have succeeded in the Preview environment and 11 of 12 have not, the task's non_goal forbids waiving any of the eight conditions, and cap-stable-promotion itself measured POST /v1/release/promote as 404, so no owner-facing promote surface even exists. Conditions 1 and 4 are unmet; the mapping fails.

checks.name: gate-verdict
checks.summary: M5 gate verdict: FAILED, and no Stable promotion is decided. Independent sufficient grounds: (i) G2 - the mandatory M5live evidence is partial, not passed, with 11 of 12 capabilities failed and a single capability evidence id; (ii) release-contract section 4 condition 2 is unmet at 1 of 12, and condition 1 is unmet because make check is red at the judgment commit; (iii) G6a - make check red at a258ed2569205dec3585d303ecb7f1c4fdba8254, introduced by the dogfood commit itself and contradicting its A21 green claim; (iv) G6b - the measured intersection between the observation-to-judgment diff and the exercised file set is 26 files, so the live observation is stale and cannot be re-observed within the remaining provider budget. Structural finding the owner must decide on: capabilities declaring Google Cloud Run (cap-preview-operation, cap-stable-promotion, cap-loop-self-update, cap-loop-control) are D1-gated by declaration, and capabilities declaring codex and opencode (cap-autonomous-resolution, cap-shared-resource-allocation, cap-provider-operation) are M6-gated by owner credential, while V2-028 (M6 live) itself depends on V2-026 - so under the current declarations the first Stable promotion is unreachable from M5 alone, and weakening the declarations to pass is explicitly forbidden. Remediation belongs to new tasks, not to this gate; the proposed outcomes are recorded in the V2-026 completion report.
